coverage_rule: When Wei is unavailable, Hayama may command a five-person detachment only when the assigned mission's required capabilities are still covered. If Wei's presence or unique capability is mission-critical, Wei deploys and Team Fujin activates its approved supervision coverage.
team_fujin_coverage: Mei Arakawa remains Team Fujin's internal acting field leader. When Wei is absent, Might Guy is the preferred supervising Jonin for joint training with his current Genin training group when Guy is available and Konoha activates the coverage. Mei does not become the legal substitute Jonin.
